brief:
An Israeli strike on a shelter in Gaza has added to mounting casualties since a ceasefire agreement took effect in October 2025, Al Jazeera English reported. The incident marks another loss of life in the enclave following months of conflict that preceded the truce.

More than 1,200 Palestinians have been killed since the ceasefire agreement began, according to the outlet's accounting. The shelter strike underscores the fragility of the agreement and the continued toll on Gaza's civilian population. Specifics on the number of casualties from the strike itself remain unclear from current reporting.
dek: More than 1,200 Palestinians have been killed since the October 2025 ceasefire agreement.
title: Israeli strike on Gaza shelter extends casualty toll
